era: Stanford home and about pages as served all through 2019 (Arquivo captures Jan, Jul, Dec 2019 and Nov 2019): cardinal #b1040e top bar with the serif 'Stanford University' wordmark and audience links, white centred main nav (News, Events, Academics, Research, Health Care, Campus Life, Admission, About), full-width video hero, story teasers, grey weather/social strip and a white footer with cardinal UPPERCASE column headings and outlined Applying/Visiting/Giving/Careers buttons, cardinal global footer.
